content.comment_body: I'm currently experiencing this issue—only [article_no] options are available, so I selected the greyed-out option for [product_name] and received the message: "[product_name]: Softkey parameter width is not suitable." Does anyone know how to resolve this? My project uses six softkeys; I've deleted and recreated them, but the error remains. Any advice would be appreciated. After posting, I noticed more replies. I've just upgraded to [product_name] [version_no].
Could you please upload your project as a ZIP file? I have [product_name] [version_no].

Thank you! Your solution worked. Could you explain how you fixed it? I'd like to know in case I need to do it again. I can save this version for new [product_name] devices, but will it also load onto older versions, or do I need multiple versions? Sometimes a program gets corrupted and we have to reload an older device. Thanks again for your help, it's greatly appreciated.
Also, could you please remove it from your blog post?

Thanks, I meant just the program—it’s company intellectual property, so I’d rather not have it shared online. Not a major issue, but it could cause future problems if someone finds and uses it, even if unlikely.
Could you share your solution? I'm experiencing the same issue.
Please upload your project as a ZIP file.

analysis.insight_summary: Users upgrading to [product_name] [version_no] encountered persistent errors regarding softkey parameter width while configuring devices, even after deleting and recreating softkeys. The error caused frustration, and while collaboration led to a working solution for some, the specific resolution remains unclear for others who later face the same problem.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect smooth configuration of multiple softkeys using [product_name] [version_no] without encountering parameter errors. They also want clear guidance on how to resolve compatibility issues between different hardware and software versions and hope for straightforward instructions when troubleshooting such errors.
